8476981.why: An experienced right winger to recognise in the supporting cast. He gives you a useful contrast with the smaller, more patient playmakers.
8476981.watch: Watch his route toward the net and whether a puck carried wide becomes a chance in the middle.

8483424.why: A young centre in this roster snapshot. Learn his habits away from the puck before expecting a highlight every shift.
8483424.watch: Watch whether he arrives low enough to give a defender an easy outlet, then supports the next pass.

8482737.why: A younger attacking option. Separate the quality of the chance he creates from whether this particular shot goes in.
8482737.watch: Watch where he goes after passing: does he find a new shooting lane or remain covered?

8481540.why: One of the first Canadiens to learn. His shooting role makes much more sense when you watch the movement before he receives the puck.
8481540.watch: Follow him without the puck: a small change of angle can turn a blocked lane into a quick release.

8481523.why: An important name when thinking about secondary offence and support through the middle. A listed position is a starting point, not a promise about his next assignment.
8481523.watch: Watch whether he can receive a difficult pass, hold possession and connect his wingers.

8476479.why: A centre to watch for the quieter work that lets a line function. An effective shift need not end with his name on a scoring play.
8476479.watch: Follow his defensive route, the faceoff assignment and the first safe pass after possession changes.

8484984.why: A young attacking talent with a lot for a new fan to notice. Treat flashes of skill and a complete, repeatable NHL shift as different questions.
8484984.watch: Watch the decision after his first move: is there a pass, shot or protected route out of pressure?

8478133.why: A useful reference for the less glamorous centre responsibilities. Watch the work that helps teammates leave their own end.
8478133.watch: Look for low support, coverage through the middle and a useful change after a difficult defensive shift.

8482775.why: Another centre to learn as the club distributes responsibility beyond its headline players. Development includes decisions and positioning as well as scoring.
8482775.watch: Watch where he stands when a defender retrieves the puck and whether he is available for the next touch.

8475184.why: An experienced left wing in this edition. He is a helpful player to follow around the crease, where useful work can happen before the final touch.
8475184.watch: Watch screens, sticks available for a tip and whether he occupies a defender while another player shoots.

8481618.why: Part of the supporting group through the middle. Follow how a forward helps move a play from defending into attacking.
8481618.watch: Watch whether he carries possession across the blue line or gives a teammate a better route in.

8483515.why: A major young forward in the Canadiens picture. His contribution is easier to spot when you follow possession through contact rather than count hits.
8483515.watch: Watch board recoveries, how he shields the puck and whether his next pass extends the attack.

8480018.why: Start here. The captain is a centre, so you can use him as your reference point for support, distribution and responsibility in both directions.
8480018.watch: Follow his next-pass choices and the support he provides below the puck, even when he is far from the net.

8480074.why: A left winger in the saved roster. Learning the supporting cast helps you judge whether useful shifts continue after the headline line changes.
8480074.watch: Watch puck recoveries, outlet positioning and how quickly he rejoins the play after a pass.

8484403.why: A young forward to distinguish from defenceman Arber Xhekaj. Same surname, different jersey number and job.
8484403.watch: Watch forecheck routes and whether pressure on a defender produces a puck recovery for his line.

8478851.why: A defensive option who shoots right. On a pair, the interesting question is often how the two players support each other.
8478851.watch: Watch retrievals under pressure and where he positions himself when his partner moves forward.

8480865.why: A prominent right-shot option on defence. Joining the attack and protecting against the next rush are connected decisions.
8480865.watch: Watch the first pass, blue-line decisions and who covers the space he leaves when he advances.

8483686.why: A young left-shot defender in this snapshot. A clean, simple exit can tell you as much about his progress as a spectacular rush.
8483686.watch: Watch shoulder checks before a retrieval, the first touch and whether his outlet gives a teammate time.

8482087.why: An important young defender to recognise. Read his availability separately from his presence in this roster snapshot.
8482087.watch: Watch the gap to an approaching attacker, recovery routes and how he protects the middle without chasing.

8483457.why: One of the easiest Canadiens to enjoy once you know what to follow. Small changes of direction can move a defender and open a passing lane.
8483457.watch: Follow the move before the pass, then check which teammate supplies cover behind him.

8476875.why: An experienced left-shot reference point on defence. A defender can create an attack well before the puck reaches the forwards.
8476875.watch: Watch the first pass out of pressure and the timing of a carry or a supporting rush.

8484220.why: A developing defender in the saved feed. A prospect appearing on a roster page does not establish a permanent NHL assignment.
8484220.watch: Watch positioning, the first pass and whether decisions stay controlled when an opponent closes quickly.

8482964.why: A recognisable physical presence on defence. A hit is most useful when it helps win possession without abandoning coverage.
8482964.watch: Watch what happens after contact: who gets the puck, and is the dangerous space still protected?

8482487.why: One of the goalies in this snapshot. Check who actually starts; a roster list is not a depth-chart ranking.
8482487.watch: Watch how he gets set before the shot, handles lateral movement and directs rebounds away from danger.

8484170.why: A young goalie whose assignment can change between the NHL club and its development system. His appearance here is not a guarantee that he dresses tonight.
8484170.watch: Watch positioning and rebound control over several sequences rather than judge him by one save or one goal.

8478470.why: A familiar name in the Canadiens crease. Availability and starting assignments need a game-day check, even when a goalie remains on the roster.
8478470.watch: Ask whether he could see the shot, whether a pass crossed the slot and what happened to the rebound.
